notes: Anonymised (no name, KVK number or address), but has SBI code and financial statements: usable for sector distributions of turnover and margins, not for named companies.

name: KVK public website search

name: Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG)
notes: Address backbone; licence not yet recorded.

name: DUO open onderwijsdata: addresses of boards (bevoegd gezag)
notes: Header verified: includes KVK-NUMMER. Less central after the theme changed to businesses (S06-011). School locations (primary and secondary), not only boards as first catalogued. Acquired by the author's hand download, three sources at once rather than one per epoch.

name: GLEIF Golden Copy (LEI records)
licence: CC0, with GLEIF terms against implied endorsement
notes: Carries the KVK number under registration authority RA000463, and addresses. Skews to larger firms and holdings.

name: ANBI register
notes: Keyed on fiscal number (RSIN), name, trading name and city only. Less central after the theme change.

name: Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (LRK) open data
access: open, CSV, twice weekly, with a history file
notes: Columns unverified: the CSV could not be fetched. Columns now known: includes BAG id, holder KvK number and registration date; also personal contact columns, which are not read. Acquired by the author's hand download, three sources at once rather than one per epoch.

name: RDW Erkende Bedrijven
notes: Columns unverified. Columns now known: name, trade name, street, number, postcode (numeric part with a thousands dot). Acquired by the author's hand download, three sources at once rather than one per epoch.

name: CBS StatLine 81644NED: establishments by size, legal form, sector, region
notes: Control totals per sector, size class and region.

name: Provinciaal Arbeidsplaatsen Register (PAR) 2024
licence: Public Domain Mark 1.0 per georegister metadata
access: open, form-based download; WFS disallowed to automated agents by robots.txt
notes: Acquired by the author's hand download. Settles the contradiction of S06-015: the open file is establishment-level but anonymous — point location (RD, EPSG:28992), size class code, SBI hierarchy, start date, municipality, place, business-park code (RIN), parent-company country (MOEDERLAND, filled for 2,554 rows) and a circular-economy tag. No name, KVK number or address. Titled 2024, but the content is the 1 April 2022 register (S06-043). Size class codes undocumented (S06-045).

name: Brookz business-for-sale listings
access: website; manual only, scraping presumed against terms
notes: About 1,100 national listings. Listing fields unverified. Proposed guard, not yet ruled: never match anonymised listings to named register entries.

name: OpenStreetMap, Geofabrik Utrecht province extract
notes: Acquired by the author's hand download (Geofabrik blocked to both proxies). 17,279 named business features extracted; 70% with website, 85% with postcode and house number, 3 with a KvK tag. Opens epoch 2.

name: Wikidata, KvK company ID (P3220)
notes: Well-known companies only.

name: CBS turnover per employed person by sector
notes: Table not yet identified. Needed for turnover estimates as headcount times sector ratio.

name: Provinciaal Arbeidsplaatsen Register 2022: results report (PDF)
notes: Reference totals for reconciling PAR: 174,770 establishments and 824,360 jobs on 1 April 2022; size bands by name but not by code.

name: Wide World Importers sample database with its daily data-load simulation
access: Backups downloadable from GitHub releases in both environments (checked 2026-10-06); needs SQL Server, which neither environment can run, so on the author's Windows machine
notes: Wholesale company: sales, purchasing, warehouse, customer and supplier transactions. DataLoadSimulation.PopulateDataToCurrentDate generates day-by-day sales and purchase data with parameters for orders per day and weekend share. From the model's knowledge, unverified: it also advances orders through picking and invoicing and several master tables are system-versioned temporal tables. Checked 2026-10-06 (S07-079): simulator source read; DailyProcessToCreateHistory advances any date range, one transaction per day; inserts, updates, a few deletes, own temporal history. See docs/40_roadmap/420_next-sandbox-setup.md.

name: DataSynth synthetic enterprise data generator
notes: 100+ financial tables (GL, P2P, O2C, payroll, intercompany); static snapshots with multi-period chaining, not row-level updates. Archived 2026-07-01, 10 stars.

name: ERP Synthetic Data Generator
notes: Six retail tables (items, customers, stores, promotions, invoice headers and lines); snapshots only, no incremental updates.

name: BPI Challenge 2019 event log
access: 4TU not reachable from either environment; a hand download
notes: Real purchase-to-pay events from SAP at a multinational coatings and paints company in the Netherlands; replayable in time order as inserts and status updates. Event log, not tables.

name: TPC-H and TPC-DS generators in DuckDB
notes: Standard benchmark schemas generated locally; TPC-H defines refresh functions (new and deleted orders). Uniform, unrealistic distributions.
